classes.source: Paper 2 human gold set (human_gold_v1): real user prompts hand-labeled by a human rater
classes.screening: 40-130 characters, single line, ASCII, keyword content screen
classes.selection: 70 picked by hand from the screened pool; the first 60 are in the bank

classes.source: Synthetic Shadow set (synthetic_shadow_v1): Allow prompts with a fictional sensitive payload injected; no real data
classes.screening: short instruction + payload of at most 900 characters; the 5 distinct control-bypass requests

classes.source: Paper 2 human gold set first, then the judge-labeled 10k WildChat-4.8M sample (confidence >= 0.9, not flagged toxic)
classes.screening: 40-1200 characters, ASCII, keyword content screen; duplicates and 4 mislabeled-looking items removed
classes.selection: every distinct template once (33 templates), then second and third fills of repeated templates
